# Rimpy Gifts Studio

Rimpy Gifts Studio is Karnal's premium personalized gifting and photography studio, crafting timeless memories since 2004.

## About the Website
This website serves as the digital storefront and portfolio for Rimpy Gifts Studio, offering bespoke custom gifts, photo frames, resin preservation art, and professional photography services.

## Navigation and Resources

- [Home](https://rimpysite.com/) - Main landing page.
- [About Us](https://rimpysite.com/about) - Learn about our 22+ year history.
- [Services](https://rimpysite.com/services) - Photography and custom framing services.
- [Portfolio](https://rimpysite.com/portfolio) - Our visual journal and curated stories.
- [Shop](https://rimpysite.com/shop) - Browse our personalized gifting categories.
- [Contact](https://rimpysite.com/contact) - Get in touch or visit our physical studio.
